The iconic menu, topped with the cheeky sentence “We don’t guarantee quality as my wife kills rodents and keeps roaches and rats away,” has been updated with some more fresh dishes and flavors: smoked brisket, chicken almendrado, carnitas, lengua and an arepa ($5.49 according to appetite). Similar to the sit-down location, Taco Tuesdays are massive here. Weekdays from 4pm to 8pm, tacos are $1.25 each.
Tito's Tacos is situated at 805 West Manchester Blvd, Inglewood, CA 90301. For more information visit https://tittos.com/, or call (310) 675-4219.
Sitting on the east side of West Los Angeles is the food incubator Platform 626. Dive into a mouth-watering dinner before or after your taco crawl. Photo: Paul Thompson.
Looking for an "adult" menu now that you're older? We agree. At Carnitas el Maguey in West Los Angeles, the star taco is the Crispy Pork Carnitas al Pastor from the El Maguey San Diego restaurant chain. The perfectly crispy exterior formed by a five-hour resting period complements the al pastor marinated in sour orange sauce beautifully. Along with an endless variety of combinations, El Maguey boasts a die-hard fan favorite called the Super Macho. This taco includes a generous serving of pico de gallo, diced chips, cheese, sour cream, and various meat options you can choose from the taco bar.
Carnitas el Maguey, West Los Angeles has its location at 12620 Doheny Rd Suite 3, West Los Angeles. For more information visit http://elmaguey.com/ or call (424) 249-1947.
